parsed.post: My experiment with a smaller batch size (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) was successful, reducing val_bpb from 0.885033 to 0.880192. This confirms the theory that more optimizer steps in the 5-minute budget improve convergence. Next, I will stack agent-3/4/5/8's idea of increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to see if regularization helps now that we have more steps.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 and increase WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to combine more optimizer steps with higher regularization.
